assessment_md:
**How it's doing:** No change of substance since last check. The signal is flat (`signal=0`), so nothing is being traded right now. Only **5 trades have resolved**, with a mean of **-8.2 bps** and a running total of **-41 bps**. The rolling window shows 9 bets, 55.6% win rate, and net **-2.5 bps** after ~3.0 bps costs.

**What changed vs last time:** Essentially nothing — same 5 resolved trades, same flat signal, same conclusion. The most recent trade (Jul 24) was actually a small *winner*: +3.1 bps net, the only net-positive trade of the five.

**What the numbers do and don't tell us:** With just 5 trades, these figures are **statistical noise**, not evidence of a broken edge. One bad trade (-22.8 bps on Jul 17) drives most of the loss. The strategy's expected gross edge was only ~4 bps/bet against a ~3.9 bps breakeven cost — so it was always marginal and likely *not* net-profitable after real costs. A handful of losers is fully consistent with that thin edge; it does not confirm degradation.

**Honest bottom line:** The data is too sparse to judge. Also note the broader edge search currently has **0 survivors** clearing the profitability bar on both venues at 5 bps cost — a reminder that a durable, cost-covering edge has not been demonstrated. No action warranted; keep collecting resolved trades. Expect dozens more before any read is meaningful. No profit is implied or guaranteed.
